name: Blueberry Kush Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Blueberry Kush is an indica strain made by crossing Blueberry and OG Kush. It has a lovely fruity sweet aroma and flavor true to its name, complemented with some light earthy undertones. This strain produces effects that slowly bring on a heavy body sensation, and relaxation. Blueberry Kush is a popular choice for evening use, as its dreamy effects will help you float into a deep sleep.
